{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DataKinds #-}
{-# LANGUAGE TypeFamilies #-}

module GrpcRoleService where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS8
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.IORef
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Word (Word8)
import System.IO (hPutStrLn, stderr)

-- | Role hierarchy for RBAC
data Role = Guest | User | Admin | SuperAdmin
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show, Read)

data Session = Session
  { sessionUser  :: T.Text
  , sessionRole  :: Role
  , sessionMeta  :: Map T.Text T.Text
  } deriving (Show)

data AuditEntry = AuditEntry
  { auditUser   :: T.Text
  , auditAction :: T.Text
  , auditDetail :: T.Text
  } deriving (Show)

type SessionStore = IORef (Map T.Text Session)
type AuditLog = IORef [AuditEntry]

-- | Initialize stores
initStores :: IO (SessionStore, AuditLog)
initStores = do
  ss <- newIORef Map.empty
  al <- newIORef []
  return (ss, al)

-- | Normalize header value by stripping leading/trailing whitespace
-- This follows HTTP/2 header semantics for gRPC metadata
normalizeHeaderValue :: BS.ByteString -> T.Text
normalizeHeaderValue bs =
  let stripped = BS8.strip bs
  in TE.decodeUtf8 stripped

-- | Encode a metadata value for transmission in gRPC trailing metadata.
-- Per gRPC spec, binary headers use base64, text headers are ASCII.
-- We sanitize control characters that could break framing.
sanitizeForTransmission :: T.Text -> BS.ByteString
sanitizeForTransmission t =
  let bs = TE.encodeUtf8 t
      -- Remove NULL bytes which could cause truncation
      filtered = BS.filter (/= 0x00) bs
  in filtered

-- | Check if a byte is a printable ASCII character or safe whitespace
isSafeHeaderByte :: Word8 -> Bool
isSafeHeaderByte w
  | w >= 0x20 && w <= 0x7E = True   -- printable ASCII
  | w == 0x09              = True   -- horizontal tab (allowed in HTTP headers)
  | otherwise              = False

-- | Validate and parse the role from metadata
parseRoleHeader :: BS.ByteString -> Either T.Text Role
parseRoleHeader bs =
  let val = normalizeHeaderValue bs
  in case T.toLower val of
    "guest"      -> Right Guest
    "user"       -> Right User
    "admin"      -> Right Admin
    "superadmin" -> Right SuperAdmin
    _            -> Left $ "Unknown role: " <> val

-- | Authenticate and create session from gRPC metadata headers
authenticateRequest :: SessionStore -> Map BS.ByteString BS.ByteString -> IO (Either T.Text Session)
authenticateRequest store headers = do
  let mUser = Map.lookup "x-user-id" headers
      mRole = Map.lookup "x-user-role" headers
      mToken = Map.lookup "authorization" headers
  case (mUser, mRole, mToken) of
    (Just userBs, Just roleBs, Just _tokenBs) -> do
      let userName = normalizeHeaderValue userBs
      case parseRoleHeader roleBs of
        Left err -> return $ Left err
        Right role -> do
          let extraMeta = Map.filterWithKey (\k _ -> BS8.isPrefixOf "x-custom-" k) headers
              metaMap = Map.mapKeys (TE.decodeUtf8) $ Map.map (TE.decodeUtf8) extraMeta
              sess = Session userName role metaMap
          modifyIORef' store (Map.insert userName sess)
          return $ Right sess
    _ -> return $ Left "Missing required authentication headers"

-- | Format an audit log entry for the structured log sink.
-- The log format is: USER|ACTION|DETAIL\n
-- Each field is validated to prevent log injection.
formatAuditEntry :: AuditEntry -> BS.ByteString
formatAuditEntry entry =
  let userBs = sanitizeForTransmission (auditUser entry)
      actionBs = sanitizeForTransmission (auditAction entry)
      detailBs = sanitizeForTransmission (auditDetail entry)
  in BS.concat [userBs, "|", actionBs, "|", detailBs, "\n"]

-- | Record an action in the audit log
recordAudit :: AuditLog -> Session -> T.Text -> T.Text -> IO ()
recordAudit logRef sess action detail = do
  let entry = AuditEntry (sessionUser sess) action detail
  modifyIORef' logRef (entry :)
  -- Also write to structured log output
  let formatted = formatAuditEntry entry
  BS8.hPutStr stderr formatted

-- | Authorization check: does the session have sufficient role?
authorize :: Role -> Session -> Bool
authorize required sess = sessionRole sess >= required

-- | Handle a "SetConfig" RPC - requires Admin role
-- Returns response metadata that includes the acting user for tracing
handleSetConfig :: SessionStore -> AuditLog -> Map BS.ByteString BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> IO (Either T.Text (BS.ByteString, Map BS.ByteString BS.ByteString))
handleSetConfig store logRef headers payload = do
  authResult <- authenticateRequest store headers
  case authResult of
    Left err -> return $ Left $ "Auth failed: " <> err
    Right sess -> do
      if authorize Admin sess
        then do
          recordAudit logRef sess "SetConfig" (TE.decodeUtf8 payload)
          -- Build response with tracing metadata
          let responseBody = "OK"
              -- Include the user identity in response metadata for distributed tracing
              tracingValue = buildTracingHeader sess
              responseMeta = Map.fromList
                [ ("x-trace-actor", tracingValue)
                , ("x-trace-role", BS8.pack $ show $ sessionRole sess)
                ]
          return $ Right (responseBody, responseMeta)
        else do
          recordAudit logRef sess "SetConfig:DENIED" (TE.decodeUtf8 payload)
          return $ Left "Insufficient permissions: Admin required"

-- | Build the tracing header value from session data.
-- This is included in gRPC response trailing metadata.
buildTracingHeader :: Session -> BS.ByteString
buildTracingHeader sess =
  let user = sessionUser sess
      metaStr = T.intercalate ";" $ map (\(k,v) -> k <> "=" <> v) $ Map.toList (sessionMeta sess)
      combined = user <> " [" <> metaStr <> "]"
  in sanitizeForTransmission combined

-- | Handle a "GetStatus" RPC - requires User role
handleGetStatus :: SessionStore -> AuditLog -> Map BS.ByteString BS.ByteString -> IO (Either T.Text BS.ByteString)
handleGetStatus store logRef headers = do
  authResult <- authenticateRequest store headers
  case authResult of
    Left err -> return $ Left $ "Auth failed: " <> err
    Right sess -> do
      if authorize User sess
        then do
          recordAudit logRef sess "GetStatus" ""
          return $ Right "STATUS:OK"
        else do
          return $ Left "Insufficient permissions: User required"

-- | Handle a "PromoteUser" RPC - requires SuperAdmin role
-- Promotes a target user to a new role
handlePromoteUser :: SessionStore -> AuditLog -> Map BS.ByteString BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> IO (Either T.Text BS.ByteString)
handlePromoteUser store logRef headers payload = do
  authResult <- authenticateRequest store headers
  case authResult of
    Left err -> return $ Left $ "Auth failed: " <> err
    Right sess -> do
      if authorize SuperAdmin sess
        then do
          let targetUser = TE.decodeUtf8 payload
          sessions <- readIORef store
          case Map.lookup targetUser sessions of
            Nothing -> return $ Left $ "User not found: " <> targetUser
            Just targetSess -> do
              let promoted = targetSess { sessionRole = Admin }
              modifyIORef' store (Map.insert targetUser promoted)
              recordAudit logRef sess "PromoteUser" targetUser
              return $ Right "PROMOTED"
        else do
          recordAudit logRef sess "PromoteUser:DENIED" (TE.decodeUtf8 payload)
          return $ Left "Insufficient permissions: SuperAdmin required"
